headline: Building tools in the shadows
narrative: Heads-down week in Stockholm, refining cursor-commands and shipflow while the overcast sky keeps things intimate. Activity's down but the work is surgical—contributing PRs, iterating on agent workflows, staying in flow. The dream pop soundtrack suggests a contemplative build phase, matching the winter rhythm.

sections.title: Cursor tooling
sections.content: Deep focus on cursor-commands and shipflow—point-and-click editing for Next.js powered by Cursor Agent. Contributed a PR to the upstream repo, iterating on the vision of making building software easier and more fun. Twenty-four commits this week, quieter than usual but purposeful.

sections.title: Quiet week, strong themes
sections.content: No posts this week, but recent threads about surgical moves over sweeping rewrites, comparing agents in context, and staying in flow. The philosophy is clear: you set the vision, agents do the execution.

footer: Overcast Stockholm, 9°C. Short days ending at 14:46, perfect for heads-down building with dream pop and trip hop keeping the vibe right.
